edits.new: The contract declares shapes, names and rules, not business values. The five schemas are the ones of section 12.1 and their properties are these, character for character from the API specification. Each row's BR Field ID is the property name in its first column. The reference-load operations are owned by P3 rwb-case, and this contract reads and applies the dictionary through rwb-source-data; the ACE value is read through the P1 data-product records; the confirmation is the role, date and document reference of `DataContractConfirmation` (ASM-B-ITG-W1-08-E1064-1 to -6). Every list of values is read through GET /api/recovery/case/v1/reference-data/{tableCode} on the rwb-case base, one hop with a 2 s timeout, with its fake; no list is written as a constant in code.
